title: Comment “Meta” and I’ll send you the full guide 👇 You can now connect ChatGPT directly to your Meta
description: Comment “Meta” and I’ll send you the full guide 👇 You can now connect ChatGPT directly to your Meta Ads and this may have just killed marketing agencies. ChatGPT can now create ads, manage campaigns, and analyze all your data directly inside the chat. Here’s how to set it up in 60 seconds: 1. Google “Meta Ads MCP” and copy the link from the first result 2. Go to ChatGPT → Apps → gear icon → Advanced Settings and turn on Developer Mode 3. Choose Create App, name it Meta Ads, paste the link, and hit Create Now just tag Meta Ads and say: “Analyze all my current ads and give me the 3 things I’m not spotting.” ChatGPT pulled the data from my account, found exactly why my ads weren’t performing, and gave me a full list of fixes. Then I just said “please fix this” and ChatGPT went into my account and made the changes so my ads actually start converting. No agency. No thousands a month. Just ChatGPT. #ai #chatgpt #metaads #facebookads #aitools
